            raise RuntimeError(f'canonical Workbench exited with {process.returncode}')

        const s = getComputedStyle(el);
        return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0 && s.display "'!== '"'none' && s.visibility "'!== '"'hidden';

      const root = document.documentElement;
      const body = document.body;
      const chartHosts = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cui-data-lab-visual-chart [data-chart-theme]')].filter(visible);
      const chartSurfaces = chartHosts.map(el => {
        const style = getComputedStyle(el);
        return {
          theme: el.getAttribute('data-chart-theme') || '',
          background: style.backgroundColor,
          color: style.color,
          width: el.getBoundingClientRect().width,
          height: el.getBoundingClientRect().height,
        };
      });
      const white = new Set(['rgb(255, 255, 255)', 'white', '#fff', '#ffffff']);
      const visibleWhiteSurface = chartSurfaces.some(item => white.has(String(item.background).toLowerCase()));
      return {
        rootTheme: root.dataset.theme || '',
        bodyDark: body.classList.contains('body--dark'),
        bodyQDark: body.classList.contains('q-dark'),
        bodyLight: body.classList.contains('body--light'),
        chartThemes: [...new Set(chartSurfaces.map(item => item.theme))].sort(),
        chartCount: chartSurfaces.length,
        chartSurfaces,
        visibleWhiteSurface,
        activeLab: document.querySelector('[data-active-lab]')?.getAttribute('data-active-lab') || '',
        tableReady: Boolean(document.querySelector('.cui-data-lab-visual-table .cui-data-table')) && Boolean(document.querySelector('.cui-data-lab-visual-table .ag-center-cols-container .ag-row')),
        chartReady: chartHosts.length > 0,
      };
    }\"\"\")
    value['expectedTheme'] = expected
    value['themeSynchronized'] = (
        value['rootTheme'] == expected
        and value['bodyDark'] == (expected == 'dark')
        and value['bodyQDark'] == (expected == 'dark')
        and value['chartThemes'] == [expected]
    ) if expected else None
    value['visualizeReady'] = bool(value['activeLab'] == 'visualize' and value['tableReady'] and value['chartReady'])
    value['noWhiteSurfaceRegression'] = not bool(value['visibleWhiteSurface'])
    return value

def set_actual_theme(page, desired: str) -> None:
    button = page.locator('[aria-label"'^="Appearance theme:"]'"').first
    button.wait_for(state='visible', timeout=10000)
    for _ in range(3):
        label = button.get_attribute('aria-label') or ''
        if label.endswith(f': {desired.title()}'):

        button.click()
